title: Pelican Bicycle Adventure

source_analysis.finding: SubmitGame Claude-vs-ChatGPT catalog entry id 'pelican-bicycle-adventure' titles it 'Pelican Bicycle Adventure' and describes a coastal Three.js cycling ride with pelican, cloth scarf physics, day/night cycle, fish collecting, adaptive quality and touch controls, with play_url https://claude-opus-5-5.riba2534.cn/ and source_url https://github.com/riba2534/claude-opus-5-5-demo.

Repository riba2534/claude-opus-5-5-demo is public, primary language JavaScript, created 2026-09-23, and contains pelican-bike/, cf-transport-ship/ and qq-speed/ directories; pelican-bike/src holds 11 modules including pelican, bicycle, ocean, fish, sky, effects and audio.

Repository README states the repo was generated by Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code with one-sentence prompts, zero manual code changes, and single-file HTML builds with fully procedural models, textures, animation and synthesized sound and no external assets.

Repository README identifies the pelican game as a coastal highway leisure ride: helmeted pelican with red scarf, cloth simulation, dusk-to-starry-night cycle, wave and surf rendering, W/S speed, A/D lane change to catch fish, Space jump, T wing-spread stunt, 14 achievements, 5 cameras, browser-synthesized music following pedaling cadence, touch buttons and frame-rate adaptive quality, with auto-drive toward fish when idle.

Playable build at https://claude-opus-5-5.riba2534.cn/ returns HTTP 200 HTML titled 'Pelican on a Bike' with #app canvas, intro card, start-ride flow and touch-action none layout, confirming a playable browser game rather than a repo page or screenshot.
Keyboard controls are explicitly documented in the playable page template: W/S accelerate and brake, A/D lane change to catch fish, Space jump, T stunt, plus B bell, C camera and U hide-UI keys.

Mobile touch controls are explicitly documented and implemented, not just responsive layout: touch button CSS and overlay, in-game touch buttons, and README phrase for touch-screen buttons with adaptive quality.
No accelerometer, gyroscope or device-motion controls are documented in the README, page template or catalog entry; motion support is unestablished.
No physical gamepad API mapping is documented in the README, page template or catalog entry; gamepad support is unestablished.

Single-player is established by design: one pelican rider, solo fish-collecting ride, 14 solo achievements and 5 camera views, with no multiplayer, co-op or versus mode documented in README, page template or catalog entry; AI or auto-drive behavior is not a human player.

Submitted MP4 is a 2808105-byte video/mp4 file dated 2026-10-02 documenting this game; the paired JPG is a title intro screen, while the live play site og:image provides inspected in-engine gameplay. No source code was cloned; only public REST, raw and Pages endpoints were inspected.

Local catalog at games/ holds 73 entries with no pelican, riba2534 or claude-opus-5-5-demo match, so no existing catalog_slug is reused; top calibration points are moorestech 64/100, Long Wind 62/100, Sakura Rally 56/100, Radikal Riders 54/100, Kart Royale 50/100 and Turbo Kart Rally 40/100.

screenshots.observation: Inspected 1200x630 in-engine gameplay close view: white pelican wearing red helmet and sunglasses with long red scarf trailing, riding a teal bicycle with wicker basket holding a fish, on a coastal asphalt road with white railing, turquoise Gerstner-style ocean waves, palm trees, pastel sunset sky, distant birds and sailboat. The game's own runtime output.

Inspected 1280x588 portrait mobile title and intro screen with black pillarbox sides: illustrated pelican-on-bike icon, Chinese title, feature chips, orange Start Ride button and keyboard control list. Menu and onboarding card, not active gameplay; discounted for graphics scoring.

screenshot_based_score.reason: Best inspected gameplay frame shows coherent stylized 3D with readable character, bicycle, basket fish, road, railing, animated-look ocean, palms and sunset composition. On par with Kart Royale (70) and Turbo Kart Rally (70) for gameplay detail and lighting, above Radikal Riders (55) on resolution and scene richness and near Sakura Rally (68), below moorestech (76) and Long Wind (74) on world density. Menu image discounted. Stills prove nothing about motion, performance or feel.

reconstructed_prompt: Generate a 3D coastal pelican bicycle ride in Three.js with a helmeted pelican, cloth scarf physics, Gerstner ocean waves, day-night cycle, fish collecting, achievements, multiple cameras, procedural Web Audio music, keyboard plus touch controls, adaptive quality and a single-file esbuild build deployable to Cloudflare Pages.
how_to_play: Open https://claude-opus-5-5.riba2534.cn/ in a desktop or mobile browser and select Start Ride.
Accelerate and brake with W and S, change lanes with A and D to chase and collect fish.
Jump with Space and trigger the wing-spread wheelie stunt with T; use B for bell and C to switch among 5 cameras.
Play with on-screen touch buttons on mobile; the pelican auto-drives toward fish when idle.
Collect fish, complete 14 achievements and ride through the dusk-to-night cycle.
mechanics: Coastal highway cycling with acceleration, braking, lane-change and jumping
Fish collecting along the road with basket pickup
Day and night cycle from dusk to starry moonlit night
Cloth-simulated red scarf and procedural pelican and bicycle animation
Gerstner-style ocean waves with shoreline surf
14 achievements and 5 cameras including cinematic and pelican views
Browser-synthesized sound and music following pedaling cadence
Touch button controls and idle auto-drive toward fish

rating.reason: Verified single-mode 3D coastal collectathon with cloth physics, day-night cycle, 14 achievements, 5 cameras, procedural audio, touch plus keyboard controls and a live browser build. Scope exceeds single-track Kart Royale (50) and Turbo Kart Rally (40) on systems and presentation and matches Radikal Riders (54) despite fewer stages, equals Sakura Rally (56) which has a larger connected world but no browser play, and sits below moorestech (64) and Long Wind (62) with no multiplayer, rivals or live-ops scale. Evidence gaps: judged from docs, config, two inspected stills and page shell only; no full playthrough, performance or balance data, so playability and tuning are not proven.

fictional_reviews.text: Fictional illustrative review one: coasting into sunset with the scarf streaming and a fish landing in the basket while the music follows my pedaling is pure cozy joy.
Fictional illustrative review two: charming ride and clever one-shot engineering, but a single coastal road with auto-drive gets repetitive and I wanted more routes or rivals.
Fictional illustrative review three: a helmeted pelican doing a wing-spread wheelie past palms under a starry sky is an instant classic screenshot machine.
